title: ISBN format/uniqueness not validated
evidence: BookApi/Book.cs:BookInput.Validate() checks title/author/year only; isbn accepted as free text with no format or uniqueness check
suggestion: Optionally validate ISBN-10/13 format and/or enforce a UNIQUE constraint — not required by the spec

title: Empty ?author= returns full list rather than empty filter
evidence: BookApi/BookRepository.cs:List — filter applies only when author is non-null; an empty-string author= would still filter to '' (matches nothing), which is acceptable but untested
suggestion: Add a test for the empty-author edge case if strict semantics matter
